name: The Parks at Arlington
summary: Popular mall with brand-name retailers, department stores, an ice rink & a multiplex movie theater.
demographics: The Parks at Arlington serves a diverse demographic base from the Arlington and mid-cities area, attracting primarily middle-income families and young professionals aged 25-54 with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $100,000. The trade area draws from Arlington's growing suburban population, including a significant mix of families with children, dual-income households, and students from nearby University of Texas at Arlington. Shoppers typically visit for convenience-oriented shopping trips, combining errands with casual dining, reflecting the practical needs of busy families and working professionals in the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex.
description: The Parks at Arlington is a vibrant outdoor shopping destination located in the heart of Arlington, Texas, offering a convenient and modern retail experience for North Texas residents. Positioned along South Cooper Street, this open-air lifestyle center serves the thriving Arlington community with a carefully curated mix of national retailers, dining options, and service providers. The center's strategic location in Arlington, situated between Dallas and Fort Worth, makes it easily accessible to a large metropolitan population seeking a convenient shopping experience. With its contemporary design and outdoor walkable environment, The Parks at Arlington provides a welcoming atmosphere where shoppers can enjoy browsing stores, dining at restaurants, and taking care of everyday needs in a comfortable setting. The center has become an integral part of Arlington's retail landscape, serving families and professionals throughout the mid-cities region of the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex.
